description: One search across companies, summarised results and call transcripts, for open questions (ChatGPT deep research and connectors use this with fetch). Companies named in the question (by ticker or name) scope the search. Returns up to 20 ids with a title and snippet; pass an id to fetch for the full text. With other MCP clients, prefer search_earnings (themes in results) or search_transcripts (exact words on calls), which take a ticker and return the text directly.

query.description: A question or words, such as 'What did Nvidia guide for next quarter?'

name: search
title: Search
